title: Spinlaunch: BUSTED (Part 2)
summary: Thunderf00t's second video critiquing SpinLaunch, the company that proposes flinging rockets and payloads into space with a giant centrifuge. He argues the idea is physically unworkable.
why: It is cited as the skeptical debunking whenever SpinLaunch comes up, not recommended as neutral analysis.

quote.text: Thunderf00t has already done two debunking videos on SpinLaunch.
